paper.title: RealCompanion: Benchmarking Human Understanding from Reasoning over Longitudinal Real-World Conversations
paper.popularityEvidence: Ranked #1 Paper of the day on Hugging Face; 259 upvotes observed during the 2026-10-06 research run.

cover.subject: African elephant
cover.promptSummary: One three-quarter elephant as a monochrome natural-history engraving on uniform pure-white #FFFFFF, with no lettering, props, scenery, frame, or watermark.

narration.alignment: Exact segment alignment from the 50 authored captions.

sourceVerification.manifest: realcompanion-manifest verify passed: 10 subjects, 27,218 messages, 2,034 chat rows, 3,312 QA items, and 3,580 profile claims.
sourceVerification.audit: realcompanion-audit all passed; all generated results matched the committed expected outputs. Twenty-two manifest gates passed and four require the withheld corpus.
sourceVerification.tests: 112 passed and 1 failed. The failing prompt-hash test references seven prompts/deployed files that are absent from the public package, so this is not represented as a complete upstream test pass.

bookVerification.build: Fresh production build with Nx cache disabled passed.
bookVerification.scenes: All five chapters passed the production-player verifier: mounted, animated, captions present, console clean, and preview captured.
bookVerification.storyboardQA: All five chapters were reviewed at 11 timeline positions; targeted clipping and caption-safe fixes were applied and rechecked.
bookVerification.blog: Five non-overlapping live Docstream sections validated; production QA found five headings, five mounted viewers, no audio elements, and no console errors.
bookVerification.cover: Built-in ImageGen elephant inspected with no lettering; committed 512 by 768 WebP has verified pure-white corners.
bookVerification.exports: Five chapter MP4s and one combined MP4 verified as H.264 plus AAC, 1280 by 720, with positive durations.

claimBoundary: Public structural counts and invariants were reproduced. Model-performance numbers are paper-reported. The rewritten conversation text is not part of the public manifest package.
